branches.text: This is a Pokémon Center. They heal your Pokémon in no time at all.
You'll be relying on them a lot, so you better learn about them.
This is a Pokémon Mart.\nThey sell Poké Balls for catching wild Pokémon and other usefull items.
Trainers will be battling their Pokémon there.
If you go a little farther, you'll see Mr. Pokémon's House.
This is the sea, as you can see.
Some Pokémon are found only in water.
Thank you for keeping up with me, I'll give you a present!
